title: Preprocessing Choices in Fine-Tuning Data Matter: Utility and Demographic Sensitivity in LLM-Based Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.03113v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have introduced a generative approach to recommendation, producing item lists from textual representations of user histories and item information. However, this generative setting raises challenges concerning output validity, prompt consistency, and sensitivity to demographic descriptors. In this work, we investigate how preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data affect recommendation utility and fairness-related behavior in a generative LLM-based recommender system. We first establish a controlled recommendation pipeline that combines supervised fine-tuning, catalog-constrained decoding, and prompt augmentation. We then study three preprocessing choices: item-title representation, demographic balancing, and auxiliary item-knowledge enrichment. translated_title: 微调数据中的预处理选择至关重要：基于大语言模型推荐系统中的效用与人口统计敏感性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型为推荐系统引入了一种生成式方法，能够根据用户历史和物品信息的文本表示生成物品列表。然而，这种生成式设置带来了输出有效性、提示一致性和对人口统计描述词敏感性方面的挑战。在这项工作中，我们研究了微调数据中的预处理选择如何影响基于大语言模型的生成式推荐系统的推荐效用和与公平性相关的行为。我们首先建立了一个结合监督微调、目录约束解码和提示增强的可控推荐流水线。随后，我们研究了三种预处理选择：物品标题表示、人口统计平衡和辅助物品知识增强。在MovieLens-1M数据集上的实验表明，目录约束流水线消除了目录外物品并确保输出完整的十个物品列表，同时提示增强（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过受控实验证明，微调数据中的预处理选择——包括物品标题表示、人口统计平衡和辅助物品知识增强——会显著影响基于大语言模型的生成式推荐系统的推荐效用和人口统计敏感性，且目录约束解码能有效保证输出的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates through controlled experiments that preprocessing choices in fine-tuning data—item-title representation, demographic balancing, and auxiliary item-knowledge enrichment—significantly affect recommendation utility and demographic sensitivity in generative LLM-based recommenders, while catalog-constrained decoding ensures valid outputs.
